messages:
sam (AE): Quick heads-up 1 customer wants to sign POC orderform today. They also uploaded a vendor security questionnaire and KMS attestation request. Need sign routing and who needs to review before esign.

jess (sales-ops): Order form is in drive: https://drive.internal/po/nebula-poc. PO amount = $12,000 initial + $4,000 activation. Customer prefers single envelope with attachments.

diego (finance): For $12k that's within sales-mgr approval. We still need vendor tax ID and billing contact before invoicing. PO attached to envelope is fine. Net30 unless buyer requests Net45.

maria (legal): Any MSA/DPA redlines attached? If the questionnaire or PO includes changes to data residency or subcontractors, we need to review prior to signing. Otherwise legal as reviewer is OK.

alex (security): I'll skim the vendor questionnaire once it's uploaded. If they ask for SOC2 artifact or KMS key-handling diagrams, we may need SRE to sign off (24-48h).

sam (AE): They included the questionnaire and a requested attestation snippet: "Redwood confirms HSM-backed key control in customer region and will provide attestation letter." They want it bundled into the envelope.

jess (sales-ops): Template match: "OrderForm-PO-Attachments-v1". DocuSign link: https://docusign.internal/templates/OF-Attach-v1. Default order AE -> Customer -> Sales Manager -> Finance. You can override sign order via API. Example: ```{
  "templateId": "OF-Attach-v1",
  "signerOrder": ["ae","sales_mgr","finance","customer_exec"]
}```

maria (legal): Drafting a one-paragraph KMS attestation we can attach. If customer insists on specific language (e.g., vendor certificate) we escalate to infra. I'll upload to legal drive.

diego (finance): Note: Finance needs a PO number in envelope metadata and the billing email. Also request to split invoices per milestone preferred by AP. Can include both options.

alex (security): I reviewed questionnaire quick pass: they asked for encryption in transit & at rest, key custody model, and SOC2 type II report. We can attach SOC2 link (redwood.security/soc2) and provide KMS addendum. SRE may need to confirm the HSM vendor statement.

sam (AE): Buyer says signature must land today for POC to start. If we need infra docs, they'll accept a follow-up attestation within 3 business days.

jess (sales-ops): Plan: prepare envelope with orderform + KMS addendum + vendor questionnaire. Set signer order: AE placeholder -> Sales Manager -> Customer Exec -> Finance (attach PO). Legal set as reviewer (post-sign). Include custom field PO_NUMBER.

maria (legal): OK to be reviewer. Uploading KMS attestation now: https://legal.internal/drafts/kms-attest-nebula-v1.docx. Minimal language confirming HSM-backed keys by region.

diego (finance): Approved for routing. If buyer wants Net45 we need director approval; flag in envelope if requested.

jess (sales-ops): Envelope ready to send once PO and billing info arrive. I'll set `signerOrder` as discussed and attach docs.

alex (security): Adding a note: if they ask for key rotation frequency or key escrow details, defer to infra. We can provide non-sensitive summary in the addendum.

sam (AE): PO just arrived + billing contact. Attaching now. Please send envelope, Jess.

jess (sales-ops): Sending envelope now. Field PO_NUMBER populated, attachments included, legal reviewer set. :white_check_mark:

diego (finance): AP received PO copy. Will process invoices after sign-off.

maria (legal): I'll watch post-sign for any redlines in the questionnaire or MSA. If none, no further action.

sam (AE): Thanks team. I'll monitor signature and confirm POC start immediately after. :rocket:
